name: Yoruba Numerals
morphology: Numbers are spoken using additive and subtractive expressions relative to multiples of 20.
hierarchy: Key units: 1–9, 10–19 as (20 − X), ogún(20), ogójì(40), ogótà(60), ogọ́rin(80).
context: The Yoruba numeric system is unique for its extensive use of subtraction in speech.
rules: Base-20 with heavy use of subtraction.
Numbers 10–19 are spoken as 20 minus X.
No positional notation; everything is phrase-based.
